claims.claim: Matched primary outcome showed no statistically significant difference between dapagliflozin and empagliflozin.
Primary-outcome results remained statistically nonsignificant across HFrEF, HFmrEF, and HFpEF strata.
Exploratory safety included a nominal DKA imbalance (9 vs 2; P=.04).
HFimpEF exploratory analysis was consistent with the main null comparative finding.
IPTW sensitivity analysis was consistent with the matched analysis.
Interpretation is limited by observational design, residual confounding, Korean population, ICD-code ascertainment, and missing adherence.
